name: lazy-stoner-donator-blood-donation

creative_direction.summary: Create one square editorial illustration for a non-material Lazy Stoner Donator wish card.
creative_direction.scene: Cannachris with a soft red drop icon and bandage heart motif, medical solidarity, no needles or graphic blood, no text.
creative_direction.character: Cannachris as a sympathetic tired-but-warm comic activist, gentle eyes, soft sleepy expression, human and kind, not intoxicated or chaotic.
creative_direction.visual_style: same clean comic style as the LSD social asset prompt: crisp outlines, warm skin tones, green cannabis-campaign accents, simple background, readable at card size, no photorealism.
creative_direction.composition: Square card image, centered character, clear symbolic action, generous padding, high contrast, works at small mobile card size.
creative_direction.text_policy: Do not render text, logos, watermarks or fake UI. The card title remains HTML text.

required_outputs.purpose: Replacement/upgrade image for the matching social wish card
required_outputs.safe_area: Keep character face and core symbol inside the central 900x650 area.

negative_prompt: no extra fingers or distorted hands
quality_checks: social action is understandable without text
works as a normal wishlist card image
